steps.text: The sun sets in the west.
Both the people and the city walls cast long shadows, covering the stalls by the road. A vendor closes his umbrella and yawns.

steps.name: Yawning Vendor
steps.text: Closing up! 30% off on what's left so I can go home for dinner!

steps.name: Bored Vendor
steps.text: Just go. Tourists these days don't care about your toy weapons anymore.

steps.name: Yawning Vendor
steps.text: I would have joined the army if I had the skills to forge real swords.

steps.name: Bored Vendor
steps.text: Say, I saw a tourist carrying a blood-red sword yesterday. Now that was something unusual. I wonder where it came from...
The girl looks around, perplexed. She has never seen a scene like this before.
The ground rumbles slightly underneath her feet, likely a sign that the nomadic city is decelerating. The people on the streets seem completely unperturbed by it, going about their business as usual.
She smells the aroma of food, and remembers that she has not eaten for two days.
The soreness all over her body hits at the same time as the hunger.
Her legs take on a mind of their own, following the scent to a restaurant.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: What would you like?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Er... whatever that person is having.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Cold noodles with roasted meat for table three!
It is near dinner time, and the place is almost full. A good, hearty dinner is the most comforting thing for honest, working people who have been busy all day.
The TV on the wall plays a martial arts drama on repeat, the familiar story occasionally catching the attention of the customers.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: (Why does the man in the box look like him?)

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: (The swordswoman next to him looks a little like Shifu, but not quite the same...)

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: (What does 'adapted from true events' mean?)

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Your noodles, miss.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: T-Thank you.

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: I say a hundred-meter scroll signed by every single person in town. Now that's a meaningful gift!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Ni sha le ma? The Grandmaster is going on a journey. How is he gonna carry that?

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Better to have something practical, like some local food for him to eat on the way.

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: How many years has the Grandmaster protected Yumen?

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: All I know that he's been around since before my dad was born.

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: He must be more than a hundred! No wonder he's leaving his post. It must take a toll on him.

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: But I've heard some jianghu wanderers say that they've seen him lately, and he still looks like he's middle-aged.

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Wait... is he immortal or something?

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: I heard there are those who live much longer than normal, thanks to Arts. The Grandmaster must be one of those.

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Anyway, the one thing everyone should remember is that he's the hero and protector of Yumen.

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Never heard about a spouse or kids, though. What a shame, when you consider that General Zuo's son has already reached adulthood...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: (They called him a hero?)

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: How did you like your meal, miss?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: It was very good.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Now, the bill...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Th-Thank you...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Sure... Now how about that, we meet again.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Did you lose your wallet, or just forgot?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I... lost it...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Ouch, that's unlucky.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Looks like you're new around here. I'm guessing you don't really know the place? I'll go with you to report the loss.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Th-Thank you, but I'm fine...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I-I'll pay you back next time!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Is this the sword you said you were looking for?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Are you trying to take it too?!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: What do you think I am, a thief?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But I've heard rumors that a special sword went missing. Could it be...?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: ...I have to go.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Show yourself!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: They say you don't try this with martial artists.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Especially not with the martial artist.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Am I a goner if he just takes a swing by instinct without looking?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Then I would have to arrest him for manslaughter.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So, did I win the bet?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You did.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I had a bet with Liang Xun over how you'd react when you saw us.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: He said you would turn around and leave, but I said you would freeze on the spot.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Never seen one who could read others better than you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, he is my oath-brother. Not exactly a stranger.

spans.text: my oath-brother. Not exactly a stranger.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Don't worry, Waai Fu doesn't know you're here.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A reunion of father and daughter calls for a grander occasion, after all.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm not like our lord magistrate over here, who drags me into trouble the first time we see each other in a dozen years.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Yes, I know I owe you one...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Is it too much sarcasm if I keep harping on this?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, there's no one else here, just the three of us.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We have wine and food. Shall we sit down and chat?

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: The locations of all the suspicious warehouses have been sent to your terminals.

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: Check them one by one, going from east to west. Move quickly; time is short.

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: Don't do anything rash, if you find something. Contact the others, and we'll move in togeth—

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Were you looking for me?
He reacts quickly. Years of experience have taught him when it is time to fight, and when it is time for flight.
As soon as he turns around, however, he feels a hand on his shoulder, immobilizing him.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Why are you trying to run, if you're looking for me?

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Sharp, but not enough guts. Fix that, and there's potential for bigger things for you.
The old man withdraws his hand.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Tell Miss Lin that I will be waiting for her at the warehouse in the southern city, on fifth street, block seven, at the Hour of Shen.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Not drinking?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I'm still on duty.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Alcohol isn't good for you.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, what are we gonna do if we're not drinking or talking? Just stare at each other?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Didn't you have something to ask him, Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I could ask you the same.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Have we gotten to the point that we can't talk while sober?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: If you have something to say, say it.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What have you been doing...?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Wandering.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Looking for strong opponents in each new place, until there's no one left. Then I move on.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I had to study Mr. Liang to see what the changes were over the years. You, Waai, or I guess Huai, you wear them on your face.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: What changed?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You got old.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: That's obvious.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I was actually worried I was going to hear someday that you died in a duel.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Would I?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: There's always someone better, as they say...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: So... how long have you been in Yumen?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Three years.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: There's someone here who promised to fight me.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: He said it could take three years, five years, ten years, maybe more.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Huai Tianpei, so obsessed with earning fame, learning patience...

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: What's a few years here? There's no one else to fight anyway.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So you've been working at the clinic for three years.
The scent of herbal medicine covers up the aroma of the wine. There is nothing left but a bitter taste.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: 'Pulsatilla yanensis', 'psychotria rubra', 'zanthoxylum avicennae', 'senecio scandens'...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I spent almost a month asking the various schools, never imagining that you were right here in this clinic opposite the inn.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Debts have to be paid.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then you know who it is you owe the biggest debt.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's all I have to say. What about you, Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Just here to see how an old friend is doing. It's not an interrogation.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Huai Tianpei has been in Yumen for three years. You've been here a while yourself. But you picked this time to visit.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's no time to consider private sentiment, when there is unrest in the city.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: In your patriotism, you won't even permit commoners like us to think of private sentiment?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What do...?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I'll sit for a while longer if you're really here to reminisce about old times.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: But look at us, we've gotten to the point where we can't even talk freely?
Huai Tianpei picks up his cup, drinks it dry, and leaves the room.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Did you get the answer you were looking for, Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I guess so.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: As Huai Tianpei's oath-brother, or as the advisor of Yumen?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I should be used to you seeing through things by now.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe you should change your habit of bringing trouble on yourself. At least don't get to the point where you don't even have someone to talk to.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: There's a job he just might be the right man for...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Like how you had me handle that goblet?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Nothing that complicated.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Even when he's Huai Tianpei, he's still Waai Tinpui.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: He's the hardest to change.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What about you and I?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The same flowers, the same wine, but the spirit of youth is no more.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's precious enough that we can still sit around the same table and chat a little over a drink. It's a fool's errand to try to go back to the past.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You're trying to stop me too?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: A lot has happened over the past couple of days. There's a lot happening that I'm not sure about.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If you mean no harm, I suggest you stay and help explain what's happening.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't have time.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Hand it over.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Did they follow you?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I don't know them.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Are you the ones who been causing trouble around town?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Stupid girl—

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: (Was she holding back when she fought me in the ring?)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: These crooks sure can bark, even if they can't bite.
